blocks.text: Building your sales operations knowledge base in Notion

Sales operations analysts often drown in scattered spreadsheets and email threads. Notion offers a way to consolidate these into a single workspace. Start by creating a database for your Standard Operating Procedures. Use the gallery view to make your documentation visual and easy to scan. When you need to add a new process, use the /page command to create a sub-page. This keeps your main dashboard clean and organized.

Writing documentation is tedious. When you have a new process to define, hold the fn key on your Mac to dictate your steps into Notion. Lazur will format your voice input into clean, structured text. This saves you from typing out long, complex instructions for your team. You can also ask Lazur to draft summaries of your meetings if you have the transcript ready.

blocks.title: Stay on top of your data

blocks.text: Common mistakes in sales operations documentation

Many analysts make the mistake of over-complicating their Notion workspace. Do not build too many nested sub-pages. This makes it hard to find information quickly. Keep your structure flat whenever possible. Another mistake is ignoring search. Use ⌘ + P to jump to any page in your workspace instantly. If you cannot find a file, check your trash folder or use the sidebar filters.

While Notion is great for documentation, keep your transactional data in your CRM. Use Notion to document the rules for that CRM data. For example, create a page that explains the lead scoring model. Link to your CRM dashboard from within Notion. This creates a bridge between your process notes and your actual performance metrics.

Notion runs best on macOS when you keep the desktop app updated. Use the Notion menu in your menu bar to check for updates regularly. If the app feels sluggish, press ⌘ + R to reload it. This clears out temporary cache issues. If you have a lot of tabs open, use the Mac Stage Manager to keep your Notion window separate from your browser.

faq.question: Can I use Notion to replace my CRM?
faq.answer: Notion is excellent for documentation and process tracking, but it lacks the specialized automation and reporting features of a dedicated CRM like Salesforce or HubSpot.

faq.question: How do I make Notion faster on my Mac?
faq.answer: Keep your workspace structure flat, limit the number of heavy databases on a single page, and ensure you are running the latest version of the Notion desktop app.

faq.question: Does Lazur work inside Notion?
faq.answer: Lazur works on your entire Mac, including Notion. You can use it to dictate text, search for documents, or ask for guidance on how to use specific Notion features.
